The '''Straits of Avangard''' are a strategic maritime chokepoint region associated with Istragarde-era disputes between [[People's Republic of Mariposa|Mariposa]], [[Imperial Rhovland|Rhovland]], and [[Astoria]].

Old source material describes two critical straits: an eastern strait between Mariposa and Rhovland-controlled territories, and a western strait between Mariposa and Astoria. Both were important for trade, resource extraction, naval movement, and Exclusive Economic Zone claims under the [[Treaty of the Concord of Istragarde]].

== Eastern Strait ==

The eastern strait became the focus of the [[Mariposa-Rhovland maritime dispute]]. Rhovland treated it as a critical route for naval and commercial fleets, while Mariposa treated the waters as a resource zone and economic opportunity.

== Western Strait ==

The western strait became the focus of the [[Mariposa-Astoria maritime dispute]]. Astoria viewed the waterway as vital to national security and shipping, while Mariposa claimed historical fishing and resource rights.

== Canon Notes ==

The source names the region but does not provide final map placement. This draft keeps the straits as a bridge geography page and avoids exact adjacency or coordinate claims until the 2003 and 2022 map references are reviewed.
